content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect handling of the scavenged static object list during garbage collection when there was only one garbage collection thread. The original code attempted to zero the static object list for all threads regardless of the number of threads, which led to a crash when accessing the list for a single thread. The patch corrects this by adding a conditional check to handle the case of a single thread separately, ensuring that the correct static object list is zeroed without causing a crash.
